problem.title: Fragmented tools become expensive incidents
problem.description: When each layer observes “in its own way,” correlation becomes slow, noise grows, and prioritization becomes guesswork.
problem.p1: Modern environments combine legacy and cloud-native. It is common to see Zabbix, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Oracle EM, plus solutions from each provider — all coexisting.
problem.p2: The result: multiple dashboards, conflicting alerts, and a long investigation chain. MTTR increases, downtime costs explode, and decisions become reactive.

faq.title:
Common questions
(with objective answers)
faq.description: If you are comparing tools or trying to escape fragmentation, here is what is most asked.

q1.q: Does VERTICE replace my current tools?
q1.a: It can coexist and unify ingestion/correlation, reducing redundancies. The path is incremental: we integrate, measure gains, and then decide on consolidation safely.

q2.q: How does it handle hybrid environments (legacy + cloud)?
q2.a: With connectors and agents (open standards like OpenTelemetry, Telegraf, Beats) and normalization strategy. The goal is to have a 'common model' of signals, regardless of origin.

q3.q: What is the role of CMDB in observability?
q3.a: It provides context: owner, criticality, dependencies, and business impact. This improves routing, prioritization, and reporting — reducing time lost investigating.

q4.a: The focus is on actionable and traceable insights: correlation, summary, cause suggestion, and next steps based on context and signal evidence.

q5.q: How do I start without a long project?
q5.a: With a result-oriented pilot: we select critical services, unify ingestion, add context, and measure noise reduction and MTTR in weeks.
